papers.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
papers.abstract: Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.

summary.takeaway: CircuitATLAS 构建了一个系统神经科学知识图谱与 agentic 工作流，用于从可测量疾病表型出发发现恢复神经环路功能的候选靶点，而非仅限于疾病相关分子。
summary.methods: 知识图谱包含 3.83M 节点和 7.66M 边，其中 5.31M 为 LLM 抽取关系；有意排除直接疾病-基因和疾病-蛋白边；整合 Human Cell Atlas 与新的多模态在体测量数据；agentic 工作流从表型经环路和细胞底物推理至分子干预、治疗可行性和临床约束；引入 human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop。
summary.relevance: 与知识图谱主题相关，展示了知识图谱与智能体推理结合用于靶点发现。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告了一个 agent 提名靶点 ATP1A3 并经在体验证，未说明该案例的代表性、图谱整体覆盖偏差、LLM 抽取关系的错误率，也未提供与其他靶点发现方法的系统比较。

papers.title: Continual Learning without Continual Training
papers.abstract: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new domains and new classes while retaining prior knowledge. Many existing methods rely on continued optimization, using regularization, replay, or parameter expansion to prevent new updates from overwriting previously learned knowledge. Instead, we propose replacing continual training with continual inference: a PFN-based model that is meta-trained, and then frozen, adapting to new classes only by extending an in-context evidence set. Our model, Latent Concept PFN, performs in-context Bayesian inference over a latent concept space that captures semantic structure shared across domains and classes. As each new domain or class arrives, exemplars are added to the memory; adaptation reflects updated posterior beliefs over latent concepts rather than gradient updates. No parameters are changed, reducing forgetting. The same method handles both domain and class incremental continual learning without task identity. Concept annotations are only used during meta-training, acting as a soft anchor on the latent space rather than a fixed bottleneck. Unlike fixed-vocabulary concept methods, the model also handles noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete annotations by combining concept labels with raw input evidence to discover distinctions beyond the predefined concept set. Experiments on class and domain incremental learning datasets demonstrate competitive continual learning performance while learning interpretable latent concepts.

summary.takeaway: Latent Concept PFN 提出用持续推理替代持续训练：通过扩展上下文证据集适应新域和新类，不改变模型参数，从而减少遗忘。
summary.methods: 基于 PFN 的模型经元训练后冻结；在潜在概念空间上进行上下文贝叶斯推断；新域或新类到来时向记忆中添加样例，通过更新潜在概念后验实现适应；概念标注仅用于元训练，作为软锚而非固定瓶颈；在类和域增量持续学习数据集上实验。
summary.relevance: 与持续学习主题直接相关，提出了一种避免梯度更新以适应新域和新类别的持续学习范式。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数据集名称、性能指标数值或与现有持续学习方法的统计比较；也未说明对大规模内存增长、极端分布偏移或大量新类的可扩展性限制。

papers.title: Catastrophic Forgetting in Sequential Thermal Anti-UAV Detection: The Role of Scale-Conditioned Gradient Imbalance
papers.abstract: Counter-UAV systems based on thermal infrared detection must stay accurate as operational datasets evolve, yet sequential fine-tuning causes catastrophic forgetting of prior tasks, a problem that remains insufficiently characterized in this domain. This continual-learning study measures the stability-plasticity trade-off in YOLOMG, a YOLOv5-based detector run as a single thermal-infrared stream with the motion channel disabled, trained sequentially across three anti-UAV benchmarks of rising scale difficulty: Anti-UAV-RGBT, Anti-UAV410, and CST Anti-UAV. Naive fine-tuning on CST yields a Forgetting Measure of -0.605 against the Stage 1 ceiling, corresponding to a 90% capability loss, with -0.572 occurring in Stage 3 alone. In contrast, knowledge distillation from a frozen teacher is associated with FM = -0.033 +/- 0.004 across three seeds, corresponding to 95% retention. Because no Stage 2 no-KD control is included, this result establishes retention under KD training rather than a causal KD effect. Per-stratum analysis shows large-target detection collapsing to near zero within the first epoch, despite an inter-stage cosine similarity of 0.987 over the gradient-updated weights, pointing to scale-conditioned gradient imbalance, rather than weight drift, as a candidate mechanism. Scale-Stratified Herding (SSH), a 300-exemplar buffer balanced across four UAV size strata, roughly halves the forgetting (FM = -0.605 to -0.311) and keeps large-target detection non-zero. An ablation attributes the gain primarily to scale stratification rather than herding: random-stratified replay performs at least as well (FM = -0.221 versus -0.311 for SSH). These replay results are single-seed and should therefore be treated as preliminary.

summary.takeaway: 在顺序热红外反无人机检测中，该研究测量 YOLOMG 的稳定性-可塑性权衡，指出尺度条件梯度不平衡可能是大目标检测崩溃的候选机制，并显示知识蒸馏与尺度分层回放可缓解遗忘。
summary.methods: 使用基于 YOLOv5 的检测器 YOLOMG，在 Anti-UAV-RGBT、Anti-UAV410、CST Anti-UAV 三个基准上顺序微调；测量遗忘指标、逐层梯度余弦相似度；比较知识蒸馏与 Scale-Stratified Herding 回放缓冲区。
summary.relevance: 与持续学习主题相关，研究了持续学习中灾难性遗忘的机制与缓解策略。
summary.caveat: 作者明确指出缺少 Stage 2 无 KD 对照，因此 KD 结果只能说明保留而非因果效应；回放结果仅单种子，属初步结果；摘要也未报告分类精度等其他任务的完整指标。

papers.title: Reliability of LLM Judges for Evaluating Entity Alignment
papers.abstract: Entity Alignment (EA) identifies equivalent entities across knowledge graphs and is critical for knowledge base integration and ontology merging. Evaluating EA systems at scale requires expensive expert annotation, making systematic assessment across diverse domains practically infeasible. LLM-as-judge evaluation offers a potentially scalable alternative, yet its reliability for structured prediction tasks like EA remains unstudied. We present the first systematic benchmarking study across three frontier models, three datasets, and four EA systems, using perturbation bias diagnostics, meta-evaluation across all dataset-judge-prompt combinations, and counterfactual label-flip tests. We identify anchor bias, a failure mode in which judges invert discrimination when the system's decision label is visible. Label exposure causally collapses judge discrimination (J-ROC-AUC 0.12-0.87), while a label-free protocol recovers near-ceiling capability on distinctive-name datasets (0.93-1.00) and significant recovery on biomedical pairs (0.93-0.95). Counterfactual experiments confirm causality (FSR 53-99%) and reveal a frontier model paradox: stronger judges exhibit greater label sensitivity, not less. A blinded two-annotator human evaluation (102 pairs, Cohen's kappa=0.902) confirms this mechanism directly. We release the first biomedical EA benchmark (MeSH-SNOMED CT, 15K pairs) and a reproducible auditing framework for LLM judge reliability in EA. Code and data are available at https://github.com/vaibhavalakshmiravideshik/llm-as-a-judge-entity-alignment.

summary.takeaway: 该研究首次系统评估 LLM-as-judge 在实体对齐任务中的可靠性，发现 anchor bias：当系统决策标签可见时，judge 的区分能力会崩溃，且更强模型反而对标签更敏感。
summary.methods: 在三个前沿模型、三个数据集、四个实体对齐系统上系统基准测试；使用扰动偏差诊断、全数据集-评判-提示组合的元评估和反事实标签翻转测试；进行双标注者盲评人类评估；发布首个生物医学实体对齐基准 MeSH-SNOMED CT 和审计框架。
summary.relevance: 与知识图谱主题相关，关注知识图谱实体对齐评估中 LLM 评判的可靠性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未详细说明三个数据集的领域覆盖、四个实体对齐系统的选择依据，也未提供标签翻转实验之外更多失败模式的系统分析；人类评估仅 102 对，规模有限。

papers.title: Privileged Context as Drift in On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a language model to match a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context. Existing work varies what privileged context contains and how it is produced while also changing models, data, and training setups, making the effects of privileged context design difficult to isolate. Motivated by efforts in continual learning to reduce catastrophic forgetting, we study how the choice of privileged context affects policy drift. Specifically, we vary two axes: content (a demonstration, feedback, or rephrase) and source (external, self-generated with a verifier, or self-generated without a verifier). We train Qwen2.5-7B with OPSD across these nine combinations and three datasets, measuring target-task accuracy, prior-task retention, reverse KL from the base policy, and parameter-update geometry. Holding source fixed, changing content spans a wider median KL range than holding content fixed and changing source. The ratio between these ranges is $5.1\times$ for per-token KL and $2.2\times$ for per-sequence KL. Parameter-update geometry shows the same pattern: updates from adapters that share content are more closely aligned (mean cosine $0.571$) than updates from adapters that share source ($0.255$). For continual learning, these findings suggest that privileged context should be treated as part of OPSD's stability design because it is associated with how far and in what direction the policy moves.

summary.takeaway: 该研究系统分离了 on-policy self-distillation 中 privileged context 的两个维度（内容与来源）对策略漂移的影响，发现内容变化比来源变化引起更大的 KL 漂移和参数更新几何差异。
summary.methods: 使用 Qwen2.5-7B 在三个数据集上训练；变化特权上下文的内容（演示、反馈、改写）和来源（外部、自生成有验证器、自生成无验证器）共九种组合；测量目标任务准确率、先前任务保留、与基础策略的反向 KL 以及参数更新几何。
summary.relevance: 与持续学习主题相关，从减少灾难性遗忘的角度研究特权上下文设计对策略稳定性的影响。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告目标任务准确率和先前任务保留的具体数值；结论基于单一模型 Qwen2.5-7B 和特定 OPSD 设置；KL 比值和余弦相似度为聚合统计，未说明统计不确定性。

papers.title: The influence of Polycomb and Trithorax group function on the sexually dimorphic abdomen pigmentation of Drosophila melanogaster.
papers.abstract: Animal traits develop through intricate patterns of gene expression that are regulated at multiple levels. This regulation includes interactions between transcription factors and cis-regulatory element DNA sequences and the dynamic accessibility of cis-regulatory elements due to chromatin modifications and remodeling. Polycomb group and Trithorax group genes are evolutionarily conserved regulators of chromatin state. Although the Polycomb group and Trithorax group genes have well understood roles in developmental gene regulation, the extent to which these complexes contribute to trait evolution remains unclear. Here, we performed a genetic screen to understand how Polycomb group and Trithorax group genes shape the rapidly evolving gene regulatory network responsible for the dimorphic abdomen tergite pigmentation of Drosophila melanogaster fruit flies. A near-comprehensive screen of Trithorax group and Polycomb group genes was conducted using RNAi, and numerous genes were identified whose reduced expression caused alterations to tergite pigmentation. For the 8 most impactful genes, their roles in regulating this gene regulatory network were explored. We assessed their effects on several key transcription factors and downstream cis-regulatory elements that are responsible for the expression of the gene regulatory network's pigmentation enzyme genes. We show that multiple members of the Polycomb group and Trithorax group complexes are required for distinct tiers in the pigmentation gene regulatory network, suggesting potential points where responsive elements for different factors may have evolved. The results set the stage for future studies to identify the direct gene regulatory network targets of Polycomb group and Trithorax group complexes and how they have participated in the evolution of this gene regulatory network.

summary.takeaway: 通过近全基因组 RNAi 筛选，该研究鉴定出多个 Polycomb 和 Trithorax 组成员参与调控果蝇腹部 tergite 色素沉着的基因调控网络，并显示这些复合物作用于网络的不同层级。
summary.methods: 对 Trithorax 组和 Polycomb 组基因进行近全面的 RNAi 筛选；对 8 个影响最大的基因，评估其对关键转录因子和下游 cis-regulatory elements 的影响。
summary.relevance: 与 GRN / Regulon 主题相关，研究染色质调控因子如何参与一个具体基因调控网络的分层调控。
summary.caveat: 摘要未列出具体筛选出的基因数量、筛选命中率，也未提供色素表型的定量测量；对 8 个基因的分析未说明是否直接结合靶标，作者也指出需要未来研究确定直接靶点。

papers.title: A systematic review of structure-activity relationships in bacterial levan: physicochemical mediation and context-dependent functionality.
papers.abstract: Bacterial levan is a β-(2 → 6)-linked fructan with variable β-(2 → 1) branching, molar-mass distribution and higher-order organization. Although these descriptors are frequently associated with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and prebiotic outcomes, the evidential basis for direct structure-activity relationships remains uncertain. We systematically reviewed 26 primary studies identified through Scopus and Web of Science Core Collection using a PRISMA 2020-informed process. Eligibility was separated from post-inclusion appraisal, and studies were classified according to whether they provided direct within-study evidence, indirect triangulated evidence or contextual observations only. Evidence was synthesized separately for chemical antioxidant assays, cell-based inflammatory models, microbial fermentation/prebiotic systems, gastrointestinal-protection models and material-performance tests. Across regimes, molar mass alone did not consistently explain activity, and few studies jointly measured polymer structure, physicochemical state and functional outcome. Diffusion, aggregation, molecular accessibility and interfacial interactions are therefore not treated as established mediators; rather, they form a testable interpretive model consistent with the available indirect evidence. Low-resolution studies were retained to characterize the evidentiary landscape but were excluded from positive mechanistic inference. This review defines the minimum analytical and experimental conditions required to test levan structure-function hypotheses and provides a chemistry-centred framework for future, within-system validation.

summary.takeaway: 该系统综述评估了细菌levan的结构-活性关系证据，指出目前缺乏直接证据支持其抗氧化、抗炎和益生元功能，并提出理化状态作为可检验的机制框架。
summary.methods: 遵循PRISMA 2020流程，从Scopus和Web of Science Core Collection筛选出26项原始研究，将证据分为直接、间接和仅背景观察三类，并分别针对化学抗氧化、细胞炎症、微生物发酵/益生元、胃肠保护及材料性能进行综合。
summary.relevance: 该文直接涉及机制推理：它不假设已确立的因果路径（如扩散、聚集、分子可及性、界面相互作用），而是将其作为基于间接证据的待检验解释模型，为课题中从关联到机制推理的方法论提供参考。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供任何具体效应量或统计结果；仅基于26项研究且多数证据为间接或背景观察，低分辨率研究被排除于积极机制推断之外，因此结论的确定性受限于现有文献质量。
